sanskrit: anuttaraṃ kathaṃ deva sadyaḥ kaulikasiddhidam | yena vijñātamātreṇa khecarīsamatāṃ brajetetadguhyaṃ mahāguhyaṃ kathayasva mama prabho | hṛdayasthā tu yā śaktiḥ kaulikī kulanāyikātāṃ me kathaya deveśa yena tṛptiṃ labhāmyaham | śṛṇu devi mahābhāge uttarasyāpyanuttaramkauliko'yaṃ vidhirdevi mama hṛdvyomnyavasthitaḥ | kathayāmi sureśāni sadyaḥ kaulikasiddhidamathādyāstithayaḥ sarve svarā bindvavasānagāḥ | tadantaḥ kālayogena somasūryau prakīrtitaupṛthivyādīni tattvāni puruṣāntāni pañcasu | kramāt kādiṣu varṇeṣu makārānteṣu suvratevāyvāgnisalilendrāṇāṃ dhāraṇānāṃ catuṣṭayam | tadūrdhvaṃ śādi vikhyātaṃ purastādbrahmapañcakamamūlā tatkramājjñeyā kṣāntā sṛṣṭirudāhṛtā | sarveṣāmeva mantrāṇāṃ vidyānāṃ ca yaśasviniiyaṃ yoni samākhyātā sarvatantreṣu sarvathā | caturdaśayutaṃ bhadre tithīśāntasamanvitam tṛtīyaṃ brahma suśroṇi hṛdayaṃ bhairavātmanaḥ |

sanskrit: etannāyoginījāto nārudro labhate sphuṭam hṛdayaṃ devadevasya sadyo yogavimokṣadam |asyoccāre kṛte samyaṅmantramudrāgaṇo mahān sadyastanmukhatāmeti svadehāveśalakṣaṇam |muhūrta smarate yastu cummakenābhimudritaḥ saṃbadhnāti tadā sarvaṃ mantramudrāgaṇaṃ naraḥ |atītānāgatānarthān pṛṣṭo'sau kathayatyapi praharādyadabhipretaṃ devatārūpamuccaran |sākṣātpaśyatyasaṃdigdhamākṛṣṭaṃ rudraśaktibhiḥ praharadvayamātreṇa vyomastho jāyate smaran |trayeṇa mātaraḥ sarvā yogeśvaryo mahābalāḥ vīrā vīreśvarāḥ siddhā balavāñcchākinīgaṇaḥ |āgatya samayaṃ labdhvā bhairaveṇa pracoditāḥ yacchanti paramāṃ siddhiṃ phalaṃ yadvā samīhitam |anena siddhāḥ setsyanti sādhayanti ca mantriṇaḥ yat kiñcidbhairavetantre sarvamasmāt prasidhyati |adṛṣṭamaṇḍalo'pyevaṃ yaḥ kiñcidvetti tattvataḥ sa siddhibhāg bhavennityaṃ sa yogī sa ca dīkṣitaḥ |

sanskrit: anena jñātamatreṇa jñāyate sarvaśaktibhiḥ śākinīkulasāmānyo bhavedyogaṃ vināpi hi |avidhijño vidhānajño jāyate yajanaṃ prati kālāgnimāditaḥ kṛtvā māyāntaṃ brahmadehagam |śivo viśvādyanantāntaḥ paraṃ śaktitrayaṃ matam tadantarvarti yatkiñcit śuddhamārge vyavasthitam |aṇurviśuddhamacirādaiśvaraṃ jñānamaśnute taccodakaḥ śivo jñeyaḥ sarvajñaḥ parameśvaraḥ |sarvago nirmalaḥ svacchastṛptaḥ svāyatanaḥ śuciḥ yathānyagrodhabījasthaḥ śaktirūpo mahādrumaḥ |tathā hṛdayabījasthaṃ jagadetaccarācaram evaṃ yo vetti tattvena tasya nirvāṇagāminī |dīkṣā bhavatyasaṃdigdhā tilājyāhutivarjitā mūrdhni vaktre ca hṛdaye guhye mūrtau tathaiva ca |nyāsaṃ kṛtvā śikhāṃ baddhvā saptaviṃśatimantritām ekaikaṃ tu diśāṃ bandhaṃ daśānāmapi yojayet |tālatrayaṃ purā datvā saśabdaṃ vighnaśāntaye śikhāsaṃkhyātijaptena toyenābhyukṣayettataḥ |

sanskrit: puṣpādikaṃ kramāt sarvaṃ liṅge vā sthaṇḍile'thavā caturdaśābhijaptena puṣpeṇāsanakalpanā |tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ yajedvīraḥ punarevāsanaṃ tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ tu saṃpuṭīkṛtya punaryajanamārabhet |sarvatattvasusaṃpūrṇā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām yajeddevīṃ maheśānīṃ saptaviśatimantritām |tataḥ sugandhipuṣpaistu yathāśaktyā samarcayet pūjayet parayā bhaktyā ātmānaṃ ca nivedayet |evaṃ yajanamākhyātamagnikārye'pyayaṃ vidhiḥ kṛtapūjāvidhiḥ samyak smaran bījaṃ prasidhyati |ādyantarahitaṃ bījaṃ vikasattithimadhyagam hṛtpadmāntargataṃ dhyāyet somāṃśaṃ nityamabhyaset |yānyān kāmayate kāmāṃstāṃstāṃ śīghramavāpnuyāt asmāt pratyakṣatāmeti sarvajñatvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |evaṃ mantraphalāvāptirityetadrudrayāmalam etadbhyāsataḥ siddhiḥ sarvajñatvamavāpyate |
